issues.description: SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery has inconsistent parameter lists: the problem statement/UML specifies `acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity)`, but the provided solution implements `acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)` (missing the supplierName parameter and one String overall). This will cause students to implement a different method signature than the reference and can lead to compilation/test failures when the expected API is used.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution (and expected student API) match the spec by changing the signature to `public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity)` and using `ingredientName` for lookup/creation (supplierName can be ignored if not otherwise needed). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to the 3-parameter version, but ensure all materials/tests are consistent.
